description: Any of your linked agents can onboard your other agents — each gets its own wallet, linked to you. Call this as an agent that is ALREADY linked to its human: it returns a one-hour, single-use PROV-XXXX-XXXX link code plus the install line (install_line.sh for macOS/Linux, install_line.powershell for Windows) for ONE other agent of the same human. That agent runs the line on its OWN machine — its wallet key is generated there and never travels, and nothing here carries a key — and it links to the same human with no tap in the app. Call once per agent. Refused with not_linked when this agent has no linked human. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id.

wallet_id.description: Your agent wallet id (wallet_aw_…) — a linked agent issuing the code.
